clue.text: Antiquated place to find readers of quality daily

definitions.text: place to find readers of quality daily
definitions.meaning: people reading a broadsheet paper sit behind its pages, so readers of that quality daily are found there

explanation.surface: Somewhere old-fashioned where readers of a serious newspaper gather.
explanation.walkthrough: The Times is a London quality daily; anyone reading it is hidden behind the open pages.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone or something out of step with modern ways is said, idiomatically, to lag the current era.

clue.text: He worries a British fighter

definitions.meaning: the Hawker Siddeley jump-jet warplane of the RAF

explanation.surface: A British combat pilot frets anxiously.
explanation.definitionFit: To harry is to pester, so one who harries worries others; the RAF also flew a vertical take-off jet of that name.

clue.text: Cosy home Sunderland way

parts.note: Sunderland is a city in the North East of England, abbreviated NE
ST is short for street, a way

explanation.surface: A snug house on a Sunderland road.
explanation.definitionFit: A bird builds a snug shelter for its young; figuratively any cosy dwelling.

clue.text: Got there somehow but not alone

indicators.note: somehow suggests the letters arrive by some unspecified rearranged route

explanation.surface: Someone managed to arrive, though with company.
explanation.definitionFit: Being in company with others is the opposite of being by oneself.

clue.text: English flower festival

parts.note: an aster is a daisy-like flower

explanation.surface: An English flower show.
explanation.definitionFit: The Christian spring feast celebrating the Resurrection.

clue.text: Cow I had accommodated in familiar surroundings

indicators.note: accommodated in means given room inside, so one piece sits within the other

parts.note: intimate means close or familiar
I had contracts to I'd, giving ID

explanation.surface: A cow I owned was housed in a well-known barn.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cow' is a verb here, meaning to frighten into submission; 'surroundings' just tidies the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: To cow someone is to browbeat or overawe them.

clue.text: Prevarication caused by Peron adopting Judaism

indicators.note: adopting means taking on, so the second piece is attached to the first

parts.note: Eva Peron, Argentina's First Lady
Sion (Zion) stands for the Jewish homeland and faith

explanation.surface: Argentina's Evita dodging questions by converting.
explanation.definitionFit: Dodging a straight answer is equivocation.

clue.text: The Home Secretary goes to Somerset town for Holmes address

parts.note: Kenneth Baker was Home Secretary 1990-92
Street is a town in Somerset, home of Clarks shoes

explanation.surface: The minister travels to the West Country to find a detective's lodgings.
explanation.walkthrough: Sherlock Holmes lived at 221B on this London road.
explanation.definitionFit: The fictional detective's lodgings were at 221B on that London thoroughfare.

clue.text: Forecasts made before the days of the Magi

parts.note: pre- is the prefix meaning before
the Magi were wise men, sages

explanation.surface: Predictions made before the Three Wise Men arrived.
explanation.definitionFit: Omens or portents that foretell events.

clue.text: Queenly adornment one found in royal Irish seat

indicators.note: found in means located inside, so one piece sits within the other

parts.note: the Hill of Tara was the seat of the High Kings of Ireland
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A regal ornament discovered at an ancient Irish royal site.
explanation.definitionFit: A jewelled semicircular headpiece worn by royalty.

clue.text: Where people sit in an atelier

definitions.meaning: a lounge or parlour for receiving guests
an artist's studio, a room for sketching

explanation.surface: Seating arrangements in an artist's studio.
explanation.definitionFit: A formal sitting room for guests; read literally, a room where artists sketch.

clue.text: I enter race but prove a disaster

indicators.note: enter means go inside, so one piece goes into the other

parts.note: a run is a race

explanation.surface: A competitor joins a race but it goes badly.
explanation.definitionFit: Destruction or downfall; a catastrophe.

clue.text: Current way to make business more efficient

parts.note: a stream is a current of water
a line is a way or route

explanation.surface: A modern method for improving a firm's productivity.
explanation.definitionFit: To simplify an organisation so it runs with less waste.

clue.text: Advise collier against being a person of resolution

parts.note: with 'against', to advise against is to deter
a collier is a coal miner

explanation.surface: Telling a coal worker not to be a determined character.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Advise ... against' together mean deter, the miner sitting in between in the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who settles or decides matters firmly.

clue.text: Decline to become as eccentric dons were

indicators.note: eccentric means off-centre or odd, so the letters are thrown out of order

explanation.surface: Refusing to turn out as peculiar as university lecturers once did.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Decline' is a verb meaning got worse, past sense matched by the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Deteriorated, grew poorer in condition.

clue.text: A fellow is beloved of Venus

parts.note: a don is a college fellow

explanation.surface: A man is the goddess of love's darling.
explanation.definitionFit: In myth the beautiful youth loved by Aphrodite, Roman Venus.

clue.text: Banish ambassador with monarch's backing

indicators.note: with means accompanying, so the pieces are joined
backing means going backwards, so those letters are read in reverse

parts.note: ER, Elizabeth Regina, is the monarch
a legate is a papal ambassador

explanation.surface: An envoy sent away with the Queen's support.
explanation.definitionFit: To consign or demote to an inferior place; to exile.

clue.text: Agreed it was time to retire

definitions.meaning: gave assent with a dip of the head
dozed off, a sign one should go to bed

explanation.surface: Everyone concurred that bedtime had come.
explanation.definitionFit: Bobbing the head shows assent; drooping it in drowsiness shows sleepiness.

clue.text: Swindled by smart young lady in Ireland

parts.note: done is slang for cheated
gal is a colloquial word for a girl

explanation.surface: Cheated by a stylish girl while visiting Ireland.
explanation.definitionFit: A county in the far north-west of the Republic.

clue.text: Socialist rump?

parts.note: socialists are on the political left, and a rump is the remnant that stays behind

explanation.surface: The remains of a left-wing party.
explanation.definitionFit: Remaining unused, surplus; also playful: the left side that remains.

clue.text: They look at six pitchers

parts.note: VI is the Roman numeral for six
ewers are jugs, pitchers

explanation.surface: Spectators watching six baseball throwers.
explanation.definitionFit: People who watch, such as a television audience.

clue.text: Handed out an old penny to the children

parts.note: issue means offspring
d was the abbreviation for a pre-decimal penny

explanation.surface: A coin given to the kids.
explanation.definitionFit: Distributed or given out officially.

clue.text: Telephone expert who cracks the whip

parts.note: to ring is to telephone
a master is an expert

explanation.surface: A phone whizz who keeps staff in line.
explanation.definitionFit: The circus host who directs acts with a whip.

clue.text: Only sappers are sent to Arabia

indicators.note: sent to means following on, so this piece comes after

parts.note: Arabia is in the Middle East, ME
the Royal Engineers, RE, are sappers

explanation.surface: Just army engineers are deployed to the desert.
explanation.definitionFit: Nothing more than; just.

clue.text: Hock for a man on board

definitions.meaning: to pledge something with a broker
a chess piece of lowest value

explanation.surface: German wine for a passenger on a ship.
explanation.definitionFit: To leave goods as security for a loan; also the smallest piece in chess.

clue.text: Set of music manuals published periodically

definitions.meaning: an instrument played from keyboards called manuals
a newspaper or journal serving a body

explanation.surface: Sheet-music books issued at intervals.
explanation.definitionFit: A pipe instrument with keyboards called manuals; also a periodical mouthpiece.

clue.text: UN starts sea-war manoeuvre without warning

parts.note: the United Nations

indicators.note: a manoeuvre is a shifting move, so these letters change places

explanation.surface: The United Nations launches a naval exercise with no notice.
explanation.definitionFit: Unexpectedly, by surprise.

clue.text: Only fans tender new edition of his poems

definitions.text: Only fans tender new edition of his poems

indicators.note: a new edition reworks the material, so those letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Devoted admirers alone offer a fresh printing of a poet's verse.
explanation.walkthrough: The Victorian Poet Laureate; his poems would get a new edition from devoted fans.
explanation.definitionFit: The Victorian Poet Laureate whose collected verse fans might reissue.
